  <script>
    function updateIstClock() {
      const now = new Date();
      const istTime = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-IN', {
        timeZone: 'Asia/Kolkata',
        hour: '2-digit',
        minute: '2-digit',
        second: '2-digit',
        hour12: false
      }).format(now);
      const clockEl = document.getElementById('admin-ist-clock');
      if (clockEl) clockEl.textContent = `${istTime} IST`;
    }
    setInterval(updateIstClock, 1000);
    updateIstClock();

    function dismissAdminAlert(btn) {
      const alert = btn.closest('.admin-toast-alert');
      if (alert) {
        alert.classList.add('fade-out');
        setTimeout(() => alert.remove(), 350);
      }
    }
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
      document.querySelectorAll('.admin-toast-alert').forEach(a => {
        setTimeout(() => {
          a.classList.add('fade-out');
          setTimeout(() => a.remove(), 350);
        }, 3500);
      });
    });

    function openCmdPalette() {
      const p = document.getElementById('admin-cmd-palette');
      p.style.display = 'flex';
      const input = document.getElementById('cmd-input');
      input.value = '';
      setTimeout(() => input.focus(), 40);
    }
    function closeCmdPalette() {
      document.getElementById('admin-cmd-palette').style.display = 'none';
    }

    window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
      if ((e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) && e.key.toLowerCase() === 'k') {
        e.preventDefault();
        openCmdPalette();
      } else if (e.key === 'Escape') {
        closeCmdPalette();
      }
    });

    let searchDebounce = null;
    const cmdInput = document.getElementById('cmd-input');
    if (cmdInput) {
      cmdInput.addEventListener('input', (e) => {
        clearTimeout(searchDebounce);
        const q = e.target.value.trim();
        if (q.length < 2) {
          document.getElementById('cmd-results').innerHTML = `
            <div style="padding:1.5rem; text-align:center; color:var(--admin-text-muted); font-size:0.85rem;">
              Type at least 2 characters to search...
            </div>
          `;
          return;
        }

        searchDebounce = setTimeout(() => {
          fetch(`/admin/api/search?q=${encodeURIComponent(q)}`)
            .then(res => res.json())
            .then(data => {
              const box = document.getElementById('cmd-results');
              box.innerHTML = '';
              if (!data.results || data.results.length === 0) {
                box.innerHTML = `<div style="padding:1.5rem; text-align:center; color:var(--admin-text-muted);">No records found matching "${q}".</div>`;
                return;
              }
              data.results.forEach(item => {
                const a = document.createElement('a');
                a.href = item.url;
                a.className = 'cmd-item';
                a.innerHTML = `
                  <div>
                    <strong style="color:var(--admin-accent);">${item.title}</strong>
                    <div style="font-size:0.75rem; color:var(--admin-text-muted);">${item.subtitle}</div>
                  </div>
                  <span class="badge badge-primary">${item.category}</span>
                `;
                box.appendChild(a);
              });
            })
            .catch(() => {});
        }, 150);
      });
    }
  </script>

<script>
function triggerCalendarPicker() {
  const input = document.getElementById('target-date-input');
  if (input.showPicker) {
    input.showPicker();
  } else {
    input.focus();
  }
}

function updateDateDisplay(dateStr) {
  if (!dateStr) return;
  const parts = dateStr.split('-');
  if (parts.length === 3) {
    const d = new Date(parts[0], parts[1] - 1, parts[2]);
    const options = { weekday: 'long', day: '2-digit', month: 'long', year: 'numeric' };
    document.getElementById('human-date-display').textContent = `Selected: ${d.toLocaleDateString('en-GB', options)} (IST)`;
  }
}

function setPresetDate(daysOffset, btn) {
  const d = new Date();
  d.setDate(d.getDate() + daysOffset);
  const formatted = d.toISOString().split('T')[0];
  document.getElementById('target-date-input').value = formatted;
  updateDateDisplay(formatted);
  document.querySelectorAll('form button.btn-sm').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active-choice'));
  btn.classList.add('active-choice');
}
</script>
{% endblock %}

<script>
// Interactive Hold & Rearrange (HTML5 Drag and Drop)
let draggedRow = null;
const tbody = document.getElementById('games-sortable-tbody');

tbody.addEventListener('dragstart', (e) => {
  draggedRow = e.target.closest('tr');
  draggedRow.style.opacity = '0.5';
  draggedRow.style.cursor = 'grabbing';
});

tbody.addEventListener('dragend', () => {
  if (draggedRow) {
    draggedRow.style.opacity = '1';
    draggedRow.style.cursor = 'grab';
    draggedRow = null;
    saveReorderedSequence();
  }
});

tbody.addEventListener('dragover', (e) => {
  e.preventDefault();
  const targetRow = e.target.closest('tr');
  if (targetRow && targetRow !== draggedRow) {
    const rect = targetRow.getBoundingClientRect();
    const next = (e.clientY - rect.top) / (rect.bottom - rect.top) > 0.5;
    tbody.insertBefore(draggedRow, next ? targetRow.nextSibling : targetRow);
  }
});

function saveReorderedSequence() {
  const rows = document.querySelectorAll('.sortable-game-row');
  const orderedIds = Array.from(rows).map(r => parseInt(r.dataset.id, 10));

  fetch('/admin/games/reorder', {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
    body: JSON.stringify({ ordered_ids: orderedIds })
  })
  .then(res => res.json())
  .then(data => {
    if (data.success) {
      const banner = document.getElementById('reorder-status');
      banner.style.display = 'block';
      setTimeout(() => banner.style.display = 'none', 3000);
    }
  })
  .catch(() => {});
}
</script>
{% endblock %}

<script>
  function updatePassageMetrics() {
    const text = document.getElementById('passage-content').value;
    const chars = text.length;
    const words = text.trim() ? text.trim().split(/\s+/).length : 0;
    document.getElementById('passage-metrics').textContent = `${words} words | ${chars} characters`;
    const preview = document.getElementById('live-preview');
    preview.textContent = text || 'Passage preview will render here...';
  }
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', updatePassageMetrics);
</script>
{% endblock %}

<script>
  function toggleAllCheckboxes() {
    const all = document.querySelectorAll('input[name="permissions"]');
    const anyUnchecked = Array.from(all).some(cb => !cb.checked);
    all.forEach(cb => cb.checked = anyUnchecked);
  }

  function toggleCategoryGroup(catClass) {
    const group = document.querySelectorAll('.cat-group-' + catClass + ' input[type="checkbox"]');
    const anyUnchecked = Array.from(group).some(cb => !cb.checked);
    group.forEach(cb => cb.checked = anyUnchecked);
  }
</script>
{% endblock %}

<script>
let isPolling = false;

function fetchLiveSessions() {
  if (isPolling) return;
  isPolling = true;

  fetch('/admin/api/sessions')
    .then(res => res.json())
    .then(data => {
      isPolling = false;
      if (!data.success) return;

      document.getElementById('live-total-count').textContent = data.active_count;
      document.getElementById('live-registered-count').textContent = data.registered_active;
      document.getElementById('live-guest-count').textContent = data.guest_active;

      const tbody = document.getElementById('sessions-tbody');
      if (!data.sessions || data.sessions.length === 0) {
        tbody.innerHTML = `
          <tr>
            <td colspan="9" style="text-align:center; padding:2.5rem; color:var(--admin-text-muted);">
              No active flight sessions detected in the last 30 minutes.
            </td>
          </tr>
        `;
        return;
      }

      let rowsHtml = '';
      data.sessions.forEach(s => {
        const roleBadge = (s.user_role === 'super_admin') 
          ? '<span class="badge badge-warning" style="font-weight:900;">SUPER ADMIN</span>'
          : ((s.user_role === 'pilot') 
              ? '<span class="badge badge-primary">ACTIVE PILOT</span>' 
              : '<span class="badge badge-warning">GUEST FLIGHT</span>');

        const callsignTag = s.callsign 
          ? `<div style="font-size:0.72rem; color:var(--admin-accent); font-family:var(--admin-mono);">[${s.callsign}]</div>` 
          : '';

        const devBadge = s.device_type === 'desktop' ? 'badge-primary' : 'badge-success';

        rowsHtml += `
          <tr>
            <td>${roleBadge}</td>
            <td>
              <div style="font-weight:700; color:var(--admin-text-main);">${s.username}</div>
              ${callsignTag}
            </td>
            <td style="font-family:var(--admin-mono); font-weight:700; color:var(--admin-accent);">${s.ip_address}</td>
            <td><strong style="color:var(--admin-text-main);">${s.location_approx}</strong></td>
            <td><span class="badge ${devBadge}">${s.device_type.toUpperCase()}</span></td>
            <td style="font-weight:700; color:var(--admin-text-main);">${s.os}</td>
            <td style="font-size:0.82rem; color:var(--admin-text-muted);">${s.browser}</td>
            <td style="color:var(--admin-text-muted); font-size:0.78rem;">${s.last_seen} IST</td>
            <td>
              <form method="POST" action="/admin/security/block-ip" style="display:inline;">
                <input type="hidden" name="ip_address" value="${s.ip_address}">
                <input type="hidden" name="reason" value="Suspicious active session block">
                <input type="hidden" name="duration_hours" value="24">
                <button type="submit" class="btn btn-sm btn-danger" onclick="return confirm('Restrict IP ${s.ip_address}?');">
                  Restrict IP
                </button>
              </form>
            </td>
          </tr>
        `;
      });
      tbody.innerHTML = rowsHtml;
    })
    .catch(() => { isPolling = false; });
}

setInterval(fetchLiveSessions, 3000);
</script>
{% endblock %}

<script>
  function toggleSelectAllUsers(master) {
    document.querySelectorAll('.user-cb').forEach(cb => cb.checked = master.checked);
    updateSelectedCount();
  }

  function updateSelectedCount() {
    const checked = document.querySelectorAll('.user-cb:checked').length;
    document.getElementById('selected-count').textContent = checked;
  }
</script>

<script>
function triggerFloatingToast(msg) {
  const toast = document.getElementById('floating-action-toast');
  toast.textContent = msg;
  toast.style.display = 'block';
  setTimeout(() => { toast.style.display = 'none'; }, 3200);
}

function saveNavAjax(id) {
  const payload = {
    label: document.getElementById('label-' + id).value,
    url: document.getElementById('url-' + id).value,
    nav_order: parseInt(document.getElementById('order-' + id).value, 10),
    for_guests: document.getElementById('guests-' + id).checked,
    for_pilots: document.getElementById('pilots-' + id).checked,
    is_visible: document.getElementById('visible-' + id).checked
  };

  fetch('/admin/website/navigation/' + id + '/edit', {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest' },
    body: JSON.stringify(payload)
  })
  .then(res => res.json())
  .then(data => {
    if (data.success) {
      triggerFloatingToast('✓ Link "' + payload.label + '" updated successfully!');
    }
  });
}

function deleteNavAjax(id) {
  if (!confirm('Remove this navigation link?')) return;
  fetch('/admin/website/navigation/' + id + '/delete', {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest' }
  })
  .then(res => res.json())
  .then(data => {
    if (data.success) {
      const row = document.getElementById('nav-row-' + id);
      if (row) row.remove();
      triggerFloatingToast('✓ Link deleted.');
    }
  });
}

function submitNavAjax(e) {
  e.preventDefault();
  const payload = {
    label: document.getElementById('new-nav-label').value,
    url: document.getElementById('new-nav-url').value,
    for_guests: document.getElementById('new-nav-guests').checked,
    for_pilots: document.getElementById('new-nav-pilots').checked
  };

  fetch('/admin/website/navigation/add', {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest' },
    body: JSON.stringify(payload)
  })
  .then(res => res.json())
  .then(data => {
    if (data.success) {
      triggerFloatingToast('✓ Link added!');
      setTimeout(() => window.location.reload(), 500);
    }
  });
}
</script>
{% endblock %}

function togglePasswordVisibility(fieldId, btn) {
    const input = document.getElementById(fieldId);
    if (!input) return;
    if (input.type === 'password') {
        input.type = 'text';
        btn.textContent = '🙈';
        btn.title = 'Hide password';
    } else {
        input.type = 'password';
        btn.textContent = '👁️';
        btn.title = 'Show password';
    }
}

<script>
// Live Countdown to 00:00 IST Midnight Rollover
function updateDailyCountdown() {
    const el = document.getElementById('daily-countdown-ist');
    if (!el) return;

    const now = new Date();
    // Indian Standard Time is UTC+5.5
    const utcTime = now.getTime() + (now.getTimezoneOffset() * 60000);
    const istNow = new Date(utcTime + (3600000 * 5.5));

    const nextMidnight = new Date(istNow);
    nextMidnight.setHours(24, 0, 0, 0);

    const diffMs = nextMidnight - istNow;
    if (diffMs <= 0) {
        el.textContent = "00:00:00 (Rollover pending)";
        return;
    }

    const hours = Math.floor(diffMs / (1000 * 60 * 60));
    const minutes = Math.floor((diffMs % (1000 * 60 * 60)) / (1000 * 60));
    const seconds = Math.floor((diffMs % (1000 * 60)) / 1000);

    el.textContent = `${String(hours).padStart(2, '0')}:${String(minutes).padStart(2, '0')}:${String(seconds).padStart(2, '0')}`;
}
setInterval(updateDailyCountdown, 1000);
updateDailyCountdown();
</script>
{% endblock %}

<script>
function filterTrophies(type) {
    document.querySelectorAll('[id^="filter-"]').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active-choice'));
    document.getElementById(`filter-${type}`).classList.add('active-choice');
    document.querySelectorAll('.trophy-card').forEach(card => {
        card.style.display = (type === 'all' || card.dataset.status === type) ? 'block' : 'none';
    });
}
</script>
{% endblock %}

{% block scripts %}
<script>
const rawPoints = {{ data_points|tojson|safe }};
let currentMetric = 'wpm';

function renderSvgChart(metric, color) {
  const container = document.getElementById('analytics-chart');
  if (!container || !rawPoints || rawPoints.length < 2) {
    container.innerHTML = '<div style="padding: 3rem; text-align: center; color: var(--text-muted);">Complete at least two tests to populate the progression curve.</div>';
    return;
  }

  const width = container.clientWidth || 800;
  const height = 240;
  const padding = 40;

  const values = rawPoints.map(p => p[metric]);
  const maxVal = Math.max(...values, metric === 'accuracy' ? 100 : 60);
  const minVal = Math.min(...values, 0);

  const getX = (idx) => padding + (idx / (rawPoints.length - 1)) * (width - 2 * padding);
  const getY = (val) => height - padding - ((val - minVal) / (maxVal - minVal || 1)) * (height - 2 * padding);

  let pathD = `M ${getX(0)} ${getY(values[0])}`;
  for (let i = 1; i < values.length; i++) {
    pathD += ` L ${getX(i)} ${getY(values[i])}`;
  }

  const svg = `
    <svg width="100%" height="${height}" viewBox="0 0 ${width} ${height}" preserveAspectRatio="none">
      <line x1="${padding}" y1="${height - padding}" x2="${width - padding}" y2="${height - padding}" stroke="#30363d" stroke-width="1"/>
      <line x1="${padding}" y1="${padding}" x2="${padding}" y2="${height - padding}" stroke="#30363d" stroke-width="1"/>
      <path d="${pathD}" fill="none" stroke="${color}" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
      ${values.map((v, i) => `
        <circle cx="${getX(i)}" cy="${getY(v)}" r="4" fill="${color}"/>
      `).join('')}
    </svg>
  `;
  container.innerHTML = svg;
}

function switchChart(metric) {
  currentMetric = metric;
  document.getElementById('btn-chart-wpm').className = metric === 'wpm' ? 'btn btn-primary' : 'btn';
  document.getElementById('btn-chart-acc').className = metric === 'accuracy' ? 'btn btn-primary' : 'btn';
  document.getElementById('btn-chart-con').className = metric === 'consistency' ? 'btn btn-primary' : 'btn';

  if (metric === 'wpm') {
    document.getElementById('chart-view-title').textContent = 'Net WPM Trajectory';
    renderSvgChart('wpm', '#58a6ff');
  } else if (metric === 'accuracy') {
    document.getElementById('chart-view-title').textContent = 'Keystroke Accuracy Stability Curve';
    renderSvgChart('accuracy', '#3fb950');
  } else {
    document.getElementById('chart-view-title').textContent = 'Interval Consistency & Regularity (%)';
    renderSvgChart('consistency', '#d29922');
  }
}

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
  switchChart('wpm');
});
</script>
{% endblock %}

<script>
const GAME_SLUG = "{{ game.slug }}";
let selectedPlayMode = 'solo_ai';
let isBlindMode = false;
let isBackspaceAllowed = true;

function setPlayMode(mode, btn) {
    selectedPlayMode = mode;
    document.querySelectorAll('#setup-play-modes .btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active-choice'));
    btn.classList.add('active-choice');

    const roomWrap = document.getElementById('setup-room-code-wrap');
    const oppWrap = document.getElementById('live-opp-wrapper');
    if (roomWrap) roomWrap.style.display = (mode === '1v1_private') ? 'block' : 'none';
    if (oppWrap) oppWrap.style.display = (mode === 'solo_practice') ? 'none' : 'block';
}

function toggleSetupToggle(type) {
    if (type === 'blind') {
        isBlindMode = !isBlindMode;
        const btn = document.getElementById('toggle-blind-btn');
        btn.textContent = isBlindMode ? 'ON' : 'OFF';
        btn.classList.toggle('active-choice', isBlindMode);
    } else if (type === 'backspace') {
        isBackspaceAllowed = !isBackspaceAllowed;
        const btn = document.getElementById('toggle-backspace-btn');
        btn.textContent = isBackspaceAllowed ? 'ON' : 'OFF';
        btn.classList.toggle('active-choice', isBackspaceAllowed);
    }
}

function openPreGameSetup() {
    document.getElementById('game-setup-screen').style.display = 'block';
    document.getElementById('game-active-arena').style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('game-results-screen').style.display = 'none';
}

function startDirectGame() {
    const diff = document.getElementById('setup-difficulty').value;
    const objVal = document.getElementById('setup-objective-val') ? document.getElementById('setup-objective-val').value : '60';
    const charMode = document.getElementById('setup-bubble-char-mode') ? document.getElementById('setup-bubble-char-mode').value : 'letters';
    const code = document.getElementById('setup-room-code') ? document.getElementById('setup-room-code').value.trim() : '';

    document.getElementById('game-setup-screen').style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('game-results-screen').style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('game-active-arena').style.display = 'block';

    window.arcadeEngine.start({
        slug: GAME_SLUG,
        playMode: selectedPlayMode,
        difficulty: diff,
        objectiveVal: objVal,
        blindMode: isBlindMode,
        backspaceAllowed: isBackspaceAllowed,
        charMode: charMode,
        roomCode: code
    });
}

function promptAbortModal() {
    window.arcadeEngine.pause();
    document.getElementById('abort-confirm-modal').style.display = 'flex';
}

function resumeFromAbortModal() {
    document.getElementById('abort-confirm-modal').style.display = 'none';
    window.arcadeEngine.resume();
}

function confirmAbortFlight() {
    document.getElementById('abort-confirm-modal').style.display = 'none';
    window.arcadeEngine.stop();
    openPreGameSetup();
}

function returnToArcade() {
    sessionStorage.setItem('typesphere_arcade_return_intent', 'true');
    window.location.href = "{{ url_for('games.index') }}#game-card-" + GAME_SLUG;
}
</script>
{% endblock %}

{% block scripts %}
<script>
function saveCurrentScroll(slug) {
    sessionStorage.setItem('typesphere_arcade_scroll_y', window.scrollY.toString());
    sessionStorage.setItem('typesphere_arcade_last_slug', slug);
}

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
    const isReturnIntent = sessionStorage.getItem('typesphere_arcade_return_intent') === 'true';
    const savedY = sessionStorage.getItem('typesphere_arcade_scroll_y');

    if (isReturnIntent && savedY !== null) {
        window.scrollTo({ top: parseInt(savedY, 10), behavior: 'smooth' });
    } else {
        window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'auto' });
    }

    sessionStorage.removeItem('typesphere_arcade_return_intent');
    sessionStorage.removeItem('typesphere_arcade_scroll_y');
    sessionStorage.removeItem('typesphere_arcade_last_slug');
});
</script>
{% endblock %}

            <div id="assess-caret" class="caret caret-smooth"></div>

{% block scripts %}
<script>
const ASSESSMENT_PASSAGES = [
    "Learning to touch type with high velocity requires relaxed hands, calm mental discipline, and consistent practice. When you anchor your fingers securely over the home keys, every upward stretch and downward reach occurs with minimal wrist displacement. Speed is the natural consequence of deliberate, mistake-free kinetic movement across every row of the keyboard.",
    "Distributed computing systems coordinate multiple autonomous computers that communicate through a shared network to solve complex analytical workloads. By partitioning high-volume data streams into immutable event logs, modern cloud infrastructures guarantee reliability and high availability even during individual node failures across global geographic availability zones."
];

let assessmentText = "";
let currentIndex = 0;
let startTime = null;
let timerInterval = null;
let timeRemaining = 60;
let errorsCount = 0;
let correctChars = 0;
let isAssessmentFinished = false;

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
    initAssessment();
});

function initAssessment() {
    assessmentText = ASSESSMENT_PASSAGES[Math.floor(Math.random() * ASSESSMENT_PASSAGES.length)];
    currentIndex = 0;
    startTime = null;
    timeRemaining = 60;
    errorsCount = 0;
    correctChars = 0;
    isAssessmentFinished = false;
    clearInterval(timerInterval);

    document.getElementById('assess-hud-wpm').textContent = '0';
    document.getElementById('assess-hud-acc').textContent = '100%';
    document.getElementById('assess-hud-err').textContent = '0';
    document.getElementById('assess-hud-time').textContent = '60s';

    document.getElementById('assess-typing-area').style.display = 'block';
    document.getElementById('assess-results-card').style.display = 'none';

    renderAssessmentPassage();

    const input = document.getElementById('assess-input');
    input.value = '';
    input.disabled = false;
    input.focus();

    input.oninput = handleAssessmentInput;
}

function renderAssessmentPassage() {
    const display = document.getElementById('assess-passage-display');
    display.innerHTML = '';
    for (let i = 0; i < assessmentText.length; i++) {
        const span = document.createElement('span');
        span.className = 'char';
        span.textContent = assessmentText[i];
        display.appendChild(span);
    }
    updateAssessmentCaret();
}

function updateAssessmentCaret() {
    const spans = document.querySelectorAll('#assess-passage-display .char');
    const caret = document.getElementById('assess-caret');
    const box = document.getElementById('assess-text-container');
    if (!caret || !box) return;

    if (currentIndex < spans.length) {
        const target = spans[currentIndex];
        caret.style.display = 'block';
        caret.style.left = `${target.offsetLeft}px`;
        caret.style.top = `${target.offsetTop + 3}px`;

        const targetMid = target.offsetTop - (box.clientHeight / 2) + 16;
        if (Math.abs(box.scrollTop - targetMid) > 16) {
            box.scrollTo({ top: Math.max(0, targetMid), behavior: 'smooth' });
        }
    } else if (spans.length > 0) {
        const last = spans[spans.length - 1];
        caret.style.left = `${last.offsetLeft + last.offsetWidth}px`;
        caret.style.top = `${last.offsetTop + 3}px`;
    }
}

function handleAssessmentInput(e) {
    if (isAssessmentFinished) return;

    if (!startTime) {
        startTime = performance.now();
        timerInterval = setInterval(tickAssessmentTimer, 1000);
    }

    const val = e.target.value;
    const spans = document.querySelectorAll('#assess-passage-display .char');
    currentIndex = Math.min(val.length, assessmentText.length);

    let mistakes = 0;
    let corrects = 0;

    for (let i = 0; i < spans.length; i++) {
        if (i < val.length) {
            if (val[i] === assessmentText[i]) {
                spans[i].className = 'char correct';
                corrects++;
            } else {
                spans[i].className = 'char incorrect';
                mistakes++;
            }
        } else {
            spans[i].className = 'char';
        }
    }

    errorsCount = mistakes;
    correctChars = corrects;
    updateAssessmentCaret();

    if (val.length > 0 && window.soundEngine) {
        const lastChar = val[val.length - 1];
        const isLastCorrect = (val.length <= assessmentText.length) && (lastChar === assessmentText[val.length - 1]);
        window.soundEngine.playKey(!isLastCorrect);
    }

    const elapsedMinutes = (performance.now() - startTime) / 60000;
    const netWords = Math.max(0, (correctChars / 5.0));
    const liveWpm = elapsedMinutes > 0 ? Math.round(netWords / elapsedMinutes) : 0;
    const liveAcc = currentIndex > 0 ? Math.round((correctChars / currentIndex) * 100) : 100;

    document.getElementById('assess-hud-wpm').textContent = liveWpm;
    document.getElementById('assess-hud-acc').textContent = `${liveAcc}%`;
    document.getElementById('assess-hud-err').textContent = errorsCount;

    if (currentIndex >= assessmentText.length) {
        assessmentText += " " + ASSESSMENT_PASSAGES[Math.floor(Math.random() * ASSESSMENT_PASSAGES.length)];
        renderAssessmentPassage();
    }
}

function tickAssessmentTimer() {
    timeRemaining--;
    document.getElementById('assess-hud-time').textContent = `${timeRemaining}s`;

    if (timeRemaining <= 0) {
        finishAssessment();
    }
}

function finishAssessment() {
    isAssessmentFinished = true;
    clearInterval(timerInterval);

    const input = document.getElementById('assess-input');
    input.disabled = true;

    const durationSec = Math.max(1, 60 - timeRemaining);
    const elapsedMinutes = durationSec / 60.0;
    const finalWpm = elapsedMinutes > 0 ? Math.round((correctChars / 5.0) / elapsedMinutes) : 0;
    const finalAcc = currentIndex > 0 ? Math.round((correctChars / currentIndex) * 100) : 100;

    let recommendedTrack = 'beginner';
    let trackTitle = "Beginner Track (0–40 WPM)";
    let trackReason = "We recommend starting with Home Row ergonomics, resting finger anchors, and posture calibration to build an unshakeable foundation.";
    let icon = "🌱";

    if (finalWpm >= 100 && finalAcc >= 95.0) {
        recommendedTrack = 'expert';
        trackTitle = "Expert Track (100+ WPM)";
        trackReason = `Extraordinary cadence! At ${finalWpm} WPM and ${finalAcc}% accuracy, you belong in Grandmaster endurance sprints and professional workplace execution.`;
        icon = "👑";
    } else if (finalWpm >= 70 && finalAcc >= 94.0) {
        recommendedTrack = 'advanced';
        trackTitle = "Advanced Track (70–100 WPM)";
        trackReason = `Excellent velocity of ${finalWpm} WPM! You are ready for complex code brackets, developer symbols, and high-speed n-gram bursts.`;
        icon = "⚡";
    } else if (finalWpm >= 40 && finalAcc >= 92.0) {
        recommendedTrack = 'intermediate';
        trackTitle = "Intermediate Track (40–70 WPM)";
        trackReason = `Solid foundation at ${finalWpm} WPM. The Intermediate Track will train contralateral Shift holds, number row reaches, and whole sentence timing.`;
        icon = "🚀";
    }

    document.getElementById('assess-typing-area').style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('assess-results-card').style.display = 'block';

    document.getElementById('assess-badge-icon').textContent = icon;
    document.getElementById('assess-track-title').textContent = trackTitle;
    document.getElementById('assess-track-reason').textContent = trackReason;

    document.getElementById('res-final-wpm').textContent = `${finalWpm} WPM`;
    document.getElementById('res-final-acc').textContent = `${finalAcc}%`;
    document.getElementById('res-final-err').textContent = errorsCount;

    const trackBtn = document.getElementById('btn-enter-track');
    trackBtn.href = `{{ url_for('learn.index') }}?track=${recommendedTrack}#track-stages`;
    trackBtn.textContent = `Enter ${recommendedTrack.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + recommendedTrack.slice(1)} Track →`;
}

function restartAssessment() {
    initAssessment();
}
</script>
{% endblock %}

        }
    }

{% block scripts %}
<script>
const targetMaterial = {{ stage.practice_material|tojson }};
const stageId = {{ stage.id }};
const minWpm = {{ stage.min_wpm_to_pass }};
const minAcc = {{ stage.min_accuracy_to_pass }};
const reqAttempts = {{ stage.required_attempts or 2 }};

let startTime = null;
let currentIdx = 0;
let errors = 0;
let isFinished = false;

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
    initLesson();
});

function initLesson() {
    startTime = null;
    currentIdx = 0;
    errors = 0;
    isFinished = false;

    document.getElementById('lesson-wpm').textContent = '0';
    document.getElementById('lesson-acc').textContent = '100%';
    document.getElementById('lesson-err').textContent = '0';

    document.getElementById('lesson-stage-arena').style.display = 'block';
    document.getElementById('lesson-result-card').style.display = 'none';

    renderLessonText();

    const input = document.getElementById('lesson-input');
    input.value = '';
    input.disabled = false;
    input.focus();

    input.oninput = handleLessonInput;
}

function renderLessonText() {
    const container = document.getElementById('lesson-text');
    container.innerHTML = '';
    const frag = document.createDocumentFragment();
    for (let i = 0; i < targetMaterial.length; i++) {
        const s = document.createElement('span');
        s.className = 'char';
        s.textContent = targetMaterial[i];
        frag.appendChild(s);
    }
    container.appendChild(frag);
    updateLessonCaret();
}

function updateLessonCaret() {
    const spans = document.querySelectorAll('#lesson-text .char');
    const caret = document.getElementById('lesson-caret');
    const box = document.getElementById('lesson-box');
    if (!caret || !box) return;

    if (currentIdx < spans.length) {
        const target = spans[currentIdx];
        caret.style.display = 'block';
        caret.style.left = `${target.offsetLeft}px`;
        caret.style.top = `${target.offsetTop + 4}px`;

        const targetMid = target.offsetTop - (box.clientHeight / 2) + 25;
        if (Math.abs(box.scrollTop - targetMid) > 20) {
            box.scrollTo({ top: Math.max(0, targetMid), behavior: 'smooth' });
        }
    } else if (spans.length > 0) {
        const last = spans[spans.length - 1];
        caret.style.left = `${last.offsetLeft + last.offsetWidth}px`;
        caret.style.top = `${last.offsetTop + 4}px`;
    }
}

function handleLessonInput(e) {
    if (isFinished) return;

    if (!startTime) {
        startTime = performance.now();
    }

    const val = e.target.value;
    const spans = document.querySelectorAll('#lesson-text .char');
    currentIdx = Math.min(val.length, targetMaterial.length);

    let mistakes = 0;
    let corrects = 0;

    for (let i = 0; i < spans.length; i++) {
        if (i < val.length) {
            if (val[i] === targetMaterial[i]) {
                spans[i].className = 'char correct';
                corrects++;
            } else {
                spans[i].className = 'char incorrect';
                mistakes++;
            }
        } else {
            spans[i].className = 'char';
        }
    }

    errors = mistakes;
    updateLessonCaret();

    if (val.length > 0 && window.soundEngine) {
        const lastChar = val[val.length - 1];
        const isLastCorrect = (val.length <= targetMaterial.length) && (lastChar === targetMaterial[val.length - 1]);
        window.soundEngine.playKey(!isLastCorrect);
    }

    const elapsedMin = (performance.now() - startTime) / 60000;
    const netWords = Math.max(0, (corrects / 5.0));
    const liveWpm = elapsedMin > 0 ? Math.round(netWords / elapsedMin) : 0;
    const liveAcc = currentIdx > 0 ? Math.round((corrects / currentIdx) * 100) : 100;

    document.getElementById('lesson-wpm').textContent = liveWpm;
    document.getElementById('lesson-acc').textContent = `${liveAcc}%`;
    document.getElementById('lesson-err').textContent = errors;

    if (val === targetMaterial) {
        isFinished = true;
        e.target.disabled = true;
        submitLessonCompletion(liveWpm, liveAcc);
    }
}

async function submitLessonCompletion(wpm, acc) {
    const passed = (wpm >= minWpm && acc >= minAcc);
    let passesSoFar = passed ? 1 : 0;
    let stageCompleted = false;

    try {
        const res = await fetch('/learn/api/complete-stage', {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
            body: JSON.stringify({ stage_id: stageId, wpm: wpm, accuracy: acc })
        });
        const data = await res.json();
        if (data && data.success) {
            passesSoFar = data.successful_attempts;
            stageCompleted = data.stage_completed;
        }
    } catch {}

    document.getElementById('lesson-stage-arena').style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('lesson-result-card').style.display = 'block';

    const icon = document.getElementById('lesson-result-icon');
    const title = document.getElementById('lesson-result-title');
    const desc = document.getElementById('lesson-result-desc');

    if (stageCompleted) {
        icon.textContent = "👑";
        title.textContent = "Stage Fully Mastered!";
        title.style.color = "var(--success)";
        desc.textContent = `Outstanding! You achieved all ${reqAttempts} required verified attempts. Progression unlocked!`;
    } else if (passed) {
        icon.textContent = "🎉";
        title.textContent = "Passing Attempt Logged!";
        title.style.color = "var(--accent)";
        desc.textContent = `Great run! You scored ${wpm} WPM and ${acc}% Accuracy. (${passesSoFar} of ${reqAttempts} verified passes logged).`;
    } else {
        icon.textContent = "⏳";
        title.textContent = "Threshold Not Reached";
        title.style.color = "var(--warning)";
        desc.textContent = `Score: ${wpm} WPM (Req: ${Math.round(minWpm)}) & ${acc}% Accuracy (Req: ${Math.round(minAcc)}%). Calm your hands and try again!`;
    }

    document.getElementById('res-wpm-val').textContent = `${wpm} WPM`;
    document.getElementById('res-acc-val').textContent = `${acc}%`;
    document.getElementById('res-passes-val').textContent = `${passesSoFar} / ${reqAttempts}`;
}

function restartLesson() {
    initLesson();
}
</script>
{% endblock %}

{% block scripts %}
<script src="https://cdn.socket.io/4.7.2/socket.io.min.js"></script>
<script>
let socket = null;
let mySid = null;
const isMobile = /Mobi|Android|iPhone|iPad/i.test(navigator.userAgent);
const platformTag = isMobile ? "Phone" : "PC";
const authUsername = "{{ current_user.username if current_user.is_authenticated else '' }}";
const myPlayerName = authUsername ? authUsername : `Pilot_${platformTag}_${Math.floor(100 + Math.random() * 900)}`;

let activeRoomData = null;
let currentPassage = "";
let currentInputIndex = 0;
let raceActive = false;
let isCountingDown = false;
let raceStartTime = null;
let clientRaceTimer = null;
let hasLocallyFinished = false;
let creationSelectedDur = 60;
let creationType = 'public';
const trackElements = {};

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
    initSocket();
    const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
    const joinParam = params.get('join') || params.get('room');
    if (joinParam) {
        setTimeout(() => {
            socket.emit('join_room', { code: joinParam.trim().toUpperCase(), player_name: myPlayerName });
        }, 450);
    }
    bindArenaInput();
    highlightActiveNavPill('public');
});

function initSocket() {
    socket = io();
    socket.on('connect', () => {
        mySid = socket.id;
        document.getElementById('socket-conn-dot').style.background = 'var(--success)';
        document.getElementById('socket-conn-text').textContent = `Online as ${myPlayerName}`;
        requestPublicRooms();
    });

    socket.on('disconnect', () => {
        document.getElementById('socket-conn-dot').style.background = 'var(--danger)';
        document.getElementById('socket-conn-text').textContent = 'Disconnected. Reconnecting...';
    });

    socket.on('public_rooms_update', (data) => {
        renderPublicRooms(data.rooms || []);
    });

    socket.on('room_joined', (data) => {
        mySid = data.your_sid;
        activeRoomData = data.room;
        currentPassage = data.room.text;
        hasLocallyFinished = false;
        showView('waiting');
        renderWaitingLobby();
    });

    socket.on('room_state_updated', (data) => {
        activeRoomData = data.room;
        currentPassage = data.room.text;
        if (activeRoomData.status === 'waiting') {
            renderWaitingLobby();
        }
    });

    socket.on('join_error', (data) => { alert(data.message || 'Unable to join flight room.'); });
    socket.on('action_error', (data) => { alert(data.message || 'Action restricted.'); });

    socket.on('quick_queue_waiting', () => {
        document.getElementById('modal-quick-searching').style.display = 'flex';
    });
    socket.on('quick_queue_cancelled', () => {
        document.getElementById('modal-quick-searching').style.display = 'none';
    });

    socket.on('quick_match_paired', (data) => {
        document.getElementById('modal-quick-searching').style.display = 'none';
        mySid = data.your_sid;
        activeRoomData = data.room;
        currentPassage = data.room.text;
        hasLocallyFinished = false;
        showView('waiting');
        renderWaitingLobby();
    });

    socket.on('match_countdown_started', (data) => {
        currentPassage = data.text;
        hasLocallyFinished = false;
        showView('arena');
        executeCountdown(data.duration || 60);
    });

    socket.on('room_progress_update', (data) => {
        renderArenaTracks(data.players || []);
    });

    socket.on('individual_player_finished', (data) => {
        const finishedPlayer = data.player;
        const isMe = (finishedPlayer.sid === mySid);
        if (isMe) {
            hasLocallyFinished = true;
            document.getElementById('finished-spectate-banner').style.display = 'flex';
            const medal = (finishedPlayer.place === 1) ? '🥇 1st' : ((finishedPlayer.place === 2) ? '🥈 2nd' : '🥉 3rd');
            document.getElementById('spectate-title').textContent = `🏁 Flight Completed: ${medal} (${Math.round(finishedPlayer.wpm)} WPM)`;
            document.getElementById('spectate-subtext').textContent = data.remaining_count > 0 
                ? `${data.remaining_count} pilot(s) still on course. You are now spectating live.`
                : 'All pilots finished!';
        }

        if (data.all_finished) {
            setTimeout(() => {
                showResultsView(data.standings);
            }, 900);
        }
    });

    socket.on('race_concluded', (data) => {
        clearInterval(clientRaceTimer);
        setTimeout(() => {
            showResultsView(data.standings);
        }, 900);
    });

    socket.on('rematch_accepted', (data) => {
        activeRoomData = data.room;
        currentPassage = data.room.text;
        hasLocallyFinished = false;
        showView('waiting');
        renderWaitingLobby();
    });

    socket.on('left_room_confirmed', () => {
        activeRoomData = null;
        hasLocallyFinished = false;
        clearInterval(clientRaceTimer);
        showView('hub');
        requestPublicRooms();
    });
}

function switchModeTab(targetMode) {
    if (activeRoomData && (activeRoomData.status === 'in_progress' || activeRoomData.status === 'countdown') && !hasLocallyFinished) {
        if (!confirm("You are in an active match. Leaving will record a DNF penalty. Proceed?")) return;
    }
    if (activeRoomData) socket.emit('leave_room_voluntary');
    cancelQuickMatchQueue();
    highlightActiveNavPill(targetMode);
    showView('hub');

    if (targetMode === 'quick') {
        startQuickMatchQueue();
    } else if (targetMode === 'private') {
        openCreateModal('private');
    } else {
        requestPublicRooms();
    }
}

function highlightActiveNavPill(activeMode) {
    const pPub = document.getElementById('tab-pill-public');
    const pQck = document.getElementById('tab-pill-quick');
    const pPrv = document.getElementById('tab-pill-private');
    pPub.className = (activeMode === 'public') ? 'btn btn-primary' : 'btn';
    pQck.className = (activeMode === 'quick') ? 'btn btn-primary' : 'btn';
    pPrv.className = (activeMode === 'private') ? 'btn btn-primary' : 'btn';
}

function showView(viewName) {
    document.getElementById('view-hub').style.display = (viewName === 'hub') ? 'block' : 'none';
    document.getElementById('view-waiting').style.display = (viewName === 'waiting') ? 'block' : 'none';
    document.getElementById('view-arena').style.display = (viewName === 'arena') ? 'block' : 'none';
    document.getElementById('view-results').style.display = (viewName === 'results') ? 'block' : 'none';
}

function safeLeaveRoom() {
    if (activeRoomData && (activeRoomData.status === 'in_progress' || activeRoomData.status === 'countdown') && !hasLocallyFinished) {
        if (!confirm("Abandon this flight match?")) return;
    }
    socket.emit('leave_room_voluntary');
}

function leaveEarlyAfterFinish() {
    socket.emit('leave_race_after_finish');
}

function requestPublicRooms() {
    if (socket && socket.connected) {
        socket.emit('request_public_rooms');
    }
}

function renderPublicRooms(rooms) {
    const tbody = document.getElementById('public-rooms-tbody');
    if (!tbody) return;
    tbody.innerHTML = '';

    if (rooms.length === 0) {
        tbody.innerHTML = `
            <tr>
                <td colspan="7" style="padding: 2.5rem; text-align: center; color: var(--text-muted);">
                    No open flight rooms waiting. Click <strong>"+ Create Public Room"</strong> to host!
                </td>
            </tr>
        `;
        return;
    }

    rooms.forEach(r => {
        const tr = document.createElement('tr');
        tr.innerHTML = `
            <td style="font-family: var(--font-mono); font-weight: 700; color: var(--accent);">${r.code}</td>
            <td style="font-weight: 600;">${r.name}</td>
            <td>${r.host_name}</td>
            <td>${r.current_players} / ${r.max_players}</td>
            <td>${r.duration}s</td>
            <td>
                <span style="background: var(--success-bg); color: var(--success); padding: 0.2rem 0.5rem; border-radius: 4px; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 700;">WAITING</span>
            </td>
            <td>
                <button onclick="joinRoomByCode('${r.code}')" class="btn btn-primary btn-sm">
                    Join Flight
                </button>
            </td>
        `;
        tbody.appendChild(tr);
    });
}

function joinRoomByCode(code) {
    socket.emit('join_room', { code: code, player_name: myPlayerName });
}

function joinRoomByCodeInput() {
    const input = document.getElementById('join-code-input');
    const code = input.value.trim().toUpperCase();
    if (!code) {
        alert('Please enter a room code.');
        return;
    }
    joinRoomByCode(code);
}

function startQuickMatchQueue() {
    socket.emit('join_quick_queue', { name: myPlayerName });
}

function cancelQuickMatchQueue() {
    socket.emit('cancel_quick_queue');
    highlightActiveNavPill('public');
}

function openCreateModal(type) {
    creationType = type;
    document.getElementById('create-modal-title').textContent = (type === 'private') ? "Host Private Flight Duel" : "Configure Public Room";
    document.getElementById('create-players-wrap').style.display = (type === 'private') ? 'none' : 'block';
    document.getElementById('modal-create-room').style.display = 'flex';
}

function closeCreateModal() {
    document.getElementById('modal-create-room').style.display = 'none';
}

function selectCreateDur(dur, btn) {
    creationSelectedDur = dur;
    document.querySelectorAll('#create-dur-group .btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active-choice'));
    btn.classList.add('active-choice');
}

function submitCreateRoom() {
    const name = document.getElementById('create-room-name').value.trim() || 'Flight Duel';
    const maxP = (creationType === 'private') ? 2 : parseInt(document.getElementById('create-max-players').value, 10);
    const customText = document.getElementById('create-custom-text').value.trim();

    socket.emit('create_room', {
        type: creationType,
        name: name,
        player_name: myPlayerName,
        duration: creationSelectedDur,
        max_players: maxP,
        custom_text: customText
    });
    closeCreateModal();
}

function renderWaitingLobby() {
    if (!activeRoomData) return;
    document.getElementById('waiting-room-code').textContent = activeRoomData.code;
    document.getElementById('waiting-room-type').textContent = activeRoomData.type.toUpperCase();
    document.getElementById('waiting-room-dur').textContent = `${activeRoomData.duration}s`;

    const container = document.getElementById('waiting-racers-list');
    container.innerHTML = '';
    const players = Object.values(activeRoomData.players || {}).filter(p => !p.left_early);
    let allReady = true;

    players.forEach(p => {
        const isMe = (p.sid === mySid);
        if (!p.ready) allReady = false;

        const div = document.createElement('div');
        div.style.display = 'flex';
        div.style.justifyContent = 'space-between';
        div.style.alignItems = 'center';
        div.style.background = isMe ? 'rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.12)' : 'var(--bg-secondary)';
        div.style.border = isMe ? '1.5px solid var(--accent)' : '1px solid var(--border-color)';
        div.style.padding = '0.75rem 1rem';
        div.style.borderRadius = 'var(--radius-sm)';
        div.innerHTML = `
            <div style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.6rem;">
                <span style="font-size: 1.2rem;">🚀</span>
                <strong style="font-size: 0.95rem;">${isMe ? `You (${p.name})` : p.name}</strong>
                ${p.is_host ? '<span style="font-size: 0.7rem; background: var(--accent); color: #04101e; padding: 0.1rem 0.45rem; border-radius: 4px; font-weight: 700;">HOST</span>' : ''}
            </div>
            <div>
                <span style="font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 700; padding: 0.25rem 0.65rem; border-radius: 4px; background: ${p.ready ? 'var(--success-bg)' : 'var(--warning-bg)'}; color: ${p.ready ? 'var(--success)' : 'var(--warning)'};">
                    ${p.ready ? '✓ Armed & Ready' : '⏳ Calibrating'}
                </span>
            </div>
        `;
        container.appendChild(div);
    });

    const amHost = (activeRoomData.host_sid === mySid);
    const hostBtn = document.getElementById('btn-host-start');
    const readyBtn = document.getElementById('btn-toggle-ready');

    if (amHost) {
        hostBtn.style.display = 'inline-flex';
        const canStart = (players.length >= 2 || activeRoomData.type === 'public') && allReady;
        hostBtn.disabled = !canStart;
        hostBtn.style.opacity = canStart ? '1' : '0.5';
    } else {
        hostBtn.style.display = 'none';
    }

    const myRecord = activeRoomData.players[mySid];
    if (myRecord) {
        readyBtn.textContent = myRecord.ready ? 'Cancel Ready' : 'Mark Ready (✓)';
        readyBtn.className = myRecord.ready ? 'btn' : 'btn btn-primary';
    }
}

function copyLobbyInvite() {
    if (!activeRoomData) return;
    const link = `${window.location.origin}/multiplayer/?join=${encodeURIComponent(activeRoomData.code)}`;
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(link).then(() => {
        const btn = document.getElementById('btn-copy-lobby');
        btn.textContent = 'Link Copied! ✓';
        btn.style.color = 'var(--success)';
        setTimeout(() => {
            btn.textContent = '📋 Copy Link';
            btn.style.color = '';
        }, 2000);
    });
}

function toggleMyReadyStatus() { socket.emit('toggle_ready'); }
function hostStartMatch() { socket.emit('start_match'); }
function requestRematch() { socket.emit('rematch_request'); }

function executeCountdown(durationSec) {
    isCountingDown = true;
    raceActive = false;
    currentInputIndex = 0;
    raceStartTime = null;
    hasLocallyFinished = false;
    document.getElementById('finished-spectate-banner').style.display = 'none';

    const banner = document.getElementById('arena-countdown-banner');
    const num = document.getElementById('arena-countdown-num');
    const statusBadge = document.getElementById('arena-status-badge');
    const input = document.getElementById('arena-cockpit-input');

    banner.style.display = 'block';
    statusBadge.textContent = 'Synchronizing starting grid...';
    input.value = '';
    input.disabled = true;
    renderArenaPassage();

    let count = 3;
    num.textContent = count;
    const cdTimer = setInterval(() => {
        count--;
        if (count > 0) {
            num.textContent = count;
        } else if (count === 0) {
            num.textContent = 'GO!';
            num.style.color = 'var(--success)';
            statusBadge.textContent = 'ENGAGED!';
            raceActive = true;
            isCountingDown = false;
            raceStartTime = performance.now();
            socket.emit('client_race_active');
            input.disabled = false;
            input.focus();
            startClientRaceTimer(durationSec);
        } else {
            clearInterval(cdTimer);
            banner.style.display = 'none';
            num.style.color = 'var(--accent)';
        }
    }, 1000);
}

function startClientRaceTimer(durationSec) {
    clearInterval(clientRaceTimer);
    let elapsed = 0;
    clientRaceTimer = setInterval(() => {
        if (!raceActive && hasLocallyFinished) return;
        elapsed++;
        const remaining = Math.max(0, durationSec - elapsed);
        if (remaining > 0) {
            document.getElementById('arena-status-badge').textContent = `Time Remaining: ${remaining}s`;
        } else {
            clearInterval(clientRaceTimer);
            socket.emit('time_expired_finish');
        }
    }, 1000);
}

function renderArenaPassage() {
    const display = document.getElementById('arena-passage-text');
    display.innerHTML = '';
    for (let i = 0; i < currentPassage.length; i++) {
        const span = document.createElement('span');
        span.className = 'char';
        span.textContent = currentPassage[i];
        display.appendChild(span);
    }
    updateArenaCaret();
}

function updateArenaCaret() {
    const spans = document.querySelectorAll('#arena-passage-text .char');
    const caret = document.getElementById('arena-caret');
    const box = document.getElementById('arena-passage-box');
    if (!caret || !box) return;

    if (currentInputIndex < spans.length) {
        const target = spans[currentInputIndex];
        caret.style.display = 'block';
        caret.style.left = `${target.offsetLeft}px`;
        caret.style.top = `${target.offsetTop + 4}px`;
        const targetMid = target.offsetTop - (box.clientHeight / 2) + 25;
        if (Math.abs(box.scrollTop - targetMid) > 20) {
            box.scrollTo({ top: Math.max(0, targetMid), behavior: 'smooth' });
        }
    } else if (spans.length > 0) {
        const last = spans[spans.length - 1];
        caret.style.left = `${last.offsetLeft + last.offsetWidth}px`;
        caret.style.top = `${last.offsetTop + 4}px`;
    }
}

function renderArenaTracks(players) {
    const container = document.getElementById('arena-tracks-container');
    players.forEach(p => {
        let track = trackElements[p.sid];
        const isMe = (p.sid === mySid);
        const label = isMe ? `🏎️ <strong>You</strong> <span style="color:var(--text-muted); font-size:0.75rem;">(${p.name})</span>` : `🏎️ <strong>${p.name}</strong>`;

        if (!track) {
            track = document.createElement('div');
            track.id = `arena-track-${p.sid}`;
            track.style.background = 'var(--bg-card)';
            track.style.padding = '0.75rem 1rem';
            track.style.borderRadius = 'var(--radius-sm)';
            track.style.border = isMe ? '1.5px solid var(--accent)' : '1px solid var(--border-color)';
            track.innerHTML = `
                <div style="display:flex; justify-content:space-between; font-size:0.85rem; margin-bottom:0.35rem;">
                    <span>${label}</span>
                    <span class="trk-speed-text" style="font-family:var(--font-mono); font-weight:700; color:${isMe ? 'var(--accent)' : 'var(--text-primary)'};">0 WPM (0%)</span>
                </div>
                <div style="background:var(--bg-secondary); height:10px; border-radius:5px; overflow:hidden;">
                    <div class="trk-speed-bar" style="width:0%; height:100%; background:${isMe ? 'var(--accent)' : '#94a3b8'}; transition:width 0.15s ease;"></div>
                </div>
            `;
            container.appendChild(track);
            trackElements[p.sid] = track;
        }

        const rankSuffix = p.place ? ` [Finished #${p.place}]` : '';
        track.querySelector('.trk-speed-text').textContent = `${Math.round(p.wpm || 0)} WPM (${Math.round(p.progress || 0)}%)${rankSuffix}`;
        const bar = track.querySelector('.trk-speed-bar');
        bar.style.width = `${p.progress || 0}%`;
        if (p.progress >= 100) bar.style.background = 'var(--success)';
    });

    const currentSids = new Set(players.map(p => p.sid));
    Object.keys(trackElements).forEach(sid => {
        if (!currentSids.has(sid)) {
            trackElements[sid].remove();
            delete trackElements[sid];
        }
    });
}

function bindArenaInput() {
    const input = document.getElementById('arena-cockpit-input');
    input.addEventListener('input', () => {
        if (!raceActive || hasLocallyFinished) {
            input.value = '';
            return;
        }

        const val = input.value;
        const spans = document.querySelectorAll('#arena-passage-text .char');
        currentInputIndex = Math.min(val.length, currentPassage.length);
        let mistakes = 0;

        for (let i = 0; i < spans.length; i++) {
            if (i < val.length) {
                if (val[i] === currentPassage[i]) {
                    spans[i].className = 'char correct';
                } else {
                    spans[i].className = 'char incorrect';
                    mistakes++;
                }
            } else {
                spans[i].className = 'char';
            }
        }

        updateArenaCaret();

        if (val.length > 0 && window.soundEngine) {
            const lastChar = val[val.length - 1];
            const isCorrect = (val.length <= currentPassage.length) && (lastChar === currentPassage[val.length - 1]);
            window.soundEngine.playKey(!isCorrect);
        }

        const progress = Math.min(100, Math.round((currentInputIndex / currentPassage.length) * 100));
        const elapsedMin = (performance.now() - raceStartTime) / 60000;
        const netWords = Math.max(0, (currentInputIndex - mistakes) / 5.0);
        const wpm = elapsedMin > 0 ? Math.round(netWords / elapsedMin) : 0;
        const accuracy = currentInputIndex > 0 ? Math.round(((currentInputIndex - mistakes) / currentInputIndex) * 100) : 100;

        socket.emit('progress_update', {
            progress: progress,
            wpm: wpm,
            accuracy: accuracy,
            errors: mistakes
        });

        if (val === currentPassage) {
            hasLocallyFinished = true;
            raceActive = false;
            input.blur();
        }
    });

    input.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
        if (e.key === ' ' && !raceActive) e.preventDefault();
    });
}

function showResultsView(standings) {
    showView('results');
    const tbody = document.getElementById('results-standings-tbody');
    tbody.innerHTML = '';

    const winner = standings[0];
    const isWinnerMe = (winner && winner.sid === mySid);
    const trophyIcon = document.getElementById('results-trophy-icon');
    const titleEl = document.getElementById('results-headline-title');
    const bannerEl = document.getElementById('results-motivational-banner');

    if (isWinnerMe) {
        trophyIcon.textContent = "🏆";
        titleEl.textContent = "VICTORY! Match Dominance!";
        titleEl.style.color = "var(--warning)";
        bannerEl.style.borderColor = "var(--warning)";
        bannerEl.style.background = "var(--warning-bg)";
        bannerEl.innerHTML = `🥇 <strong>Podium Gold!</strong> Superior cadence carried you across the finish line first!`;
    } else {
        trophyIcon.textContent = "🏁";
        titleEl.textContent = "Duel Concluded";
        titleEl.style.color = "var(--accent)";
        bannerEl.style.borderColor = "var(--accent)";
        bannerEl.style.background = "var(--accent-glow)";
        const myIndex = standings.findIndex(p => p.sid === mySid);
        const myRank = myIndex + 1;
        bannerEl.innerHTML = `You completed the course in <strong>#${myRank > 0 ? myRank : 'DNF'}</strong>. Practice compounds velocity!`;
    }

    standings.forEach((p, idx) => {
        const isMe = (p.sid === mySid);
        const tr = document.createElement('tr');
        if (isMe) tr.style.background = 'rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.1)';

        const medal = (idx === 0) ? '🥇 1st' : ((idx === 1) ? '🥈 2nd' : ((idx === 2) ? '🥉 3rd' : `${idx + 1}th`));
        const statusTag = p.left_early 
            ? '<span style="color:var(--danger); font-weight:700;">DNF / Disconnected</span>' 
            : (p.finished ? '<span style="color:var(--success); font-weight:700;">Finished</span>' : '<span style="color:var(--warning); font-weight:700;">On Course</span>');

        // Elo Delta Readout (+24 MMR / -16 MMR)
        let eloTag = '<span style="color:var(--text-muted); font-size:0.8rem;">Guest (Unranked)</span>';
        if (p.elo_delta !== undefined && p.elo_delta !== 0) {
            const sign = p.elo_delta > 0 ? '+' : '';
            const color = p.elo_delta > 0 ? 'var(--success)' : 'var(--danger)';
            eloTag = `<strong style="color:${color}; font-family:var(--font-mono);">${sign}${p.elo_delta} MMR</strong> <span style="font-size:0.75rem; color:var(--text-muted);">(${p.new_elo || ''})</span>`;
        } else if (p.user_id) {
            eloTag = `<span style="color:var(--text-muted); font-family:var(--font-mono); font-size:0.85rem;">0 MMR</span>`;
        }

        tr.innerHTML = `
            <td style="font-weight: 800; color: ${idx === 0 ? 'var(--warning)' : 'var(--text-primary)'};">${medal}</td>
            <td style="font-weight: 700;">${isMe ? `You (${p.name})` : p.name}</td>
            <td style="font-family: var(--font-mono); font-weight: 800; color: var(--accent);">${Math.round(p.wpm || 0)} WPM</td>
            <td>${Math.round(p.accuracy || 100)}%</td>
            <td style="color: var(--danger); font-weight: 700;">${p.errors || 0}</td>
            <td>${eloTag}</td>
            <td>${statusTag}</td>
        `;
        tbody.appendChild(tr);
    });
}

{% block scripts %}
<script>
function handleSandboxKey(e) {
    if (window.soundEngine) {
        window.soundEngine.playKey(e.key === 'Backspace');
    }
}

function onSoundVolumeSlide(val) {
    const floatVal = parseInt(val, 10) / 100.0;
    document.getElementById('sound-volume-label').textContent = `${val}%`;
    window.settingsManager.update('sound_volume', floatVal);
    if (window.soundEngine) {
        window.soundEngine.setVolume(floatVal);
        window.soundEngine.playKey(false);
    }
}

function toggleSoundMute() {
    const next = !window.settingsManager.current.sound_enabled;
    window.settingsManager.update('sound_enabled', next);
}

function toggleDefaultBlind() {
    const next = !window.settingsManager.current.blind_mode;
    window.settingsManager.update('blind_mode', next);
}

function toggleDefaultGhost() {
    const next = !window.settingsManager.current.ghost_mode;
    window.settingsManager.update('ghost_mode', next);
}

function toggleReducedMotion() {
    const next = !window.settingsManager.current.reduce_motion;
    window.settingsManager.update('reduce_motion', next);
}
</script>
{% endblock %}

{% block scripts %}
<script>
let selectedCustomDuration = 60;
const PRESETS = {
    exam: "GOVERNMENT OF INDIA, STAFF SELECTION COMMISSION. The implementation of unified administrative procedures across civil secretariats ensures transparent, accountable governance. Every official communication must uphold statutory standards, ensuring clarity of public obligations and timely execution of ministerial directives without arbitrary deviations.",
    tech: "Distributed event streaming architectures enable microservices to communicate asynchronously with high throughput and resilience against node failures through immutable append-only commit logs. Partition leaders rebalance autonomously to sustain uninterrupted data flows.",
    code: "class TokenBucket:\n    def __init__(self, rate: float, capacity: float):\n        self.rate = rate\n        self.capacity = capacity\n        self.tokens = capacity\n        self.last = time.time()"
};

function selectDuration(seconds, btn) {
    selectedCustomDuration = seconds;
    document.querySelectorAll('#duration-selector .btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active-choice'));
    btn.classList.add('active-choice');
}

function updateStats() {
    const text = document.getElementById('custom-studio-input').value.trim();
    const words = text ? text.split(/\s+/).length : 0;
    const chars = text.length;
    const estSeconds = Math.round((words / 60) * 60);
    document.getElementById('stat-word-count').textContent = words;
    document.getElementById('stat-char-count').textContent = chars;
    document.getElementById('stat-est-time').textContent = `${estSeconds}s`;
}

function loadPreset(key) {
    document.getElementById('custom-studio-input').value = PRESETS[key];
    updateStats();
}

function clearText() {
    document.getElementById('custom-studio-input').value = '';
    updateStats();
}

function launchCustomTest() {
    const text = document.getElementById('custom-studio-input').value.trim();
    if (!text || text.length < 5) {
        alert('Please enter at least 5 characters to start a custom practice run.');
        return;
    }
    sessionStorage.setItem('typesphere_custom_text', text);
    sessionStorage.setItem('typesphere_custom_duration', selectedCustomDuration.toString());
    window.location.href = "{{ url_for('typing.test_page') }}?mode=custom";
}

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
    updateStats();
});
</script>
{% endblock %}

{% block scripts %}
<script>
const rawEvents = {{ events_json|safe if events_json else '[]' }};
const targetPassage = {{ target_text|tojson|safe if target_text else '""' }};
const totalDuration = {{ test.duration }};

let replayIndex = 0;
let isReplaying = false;
let replayTimer = null;
let replaySpeed = 1.0;

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
    // Snap window to top so the results card is centered
    window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'instant' });

    // 1. Render Timeline Chart
    try {
        const rawData = {{ test.timeline_data|tojson|safe if test.timeline_data else '[]' }};
        const timelineData = typeof rawData === 'string' ? JSON.parse(rawData) : rawData;
        if (Array.isArray(timelineData) && timelineData.length > 1) {
            SvgLineChart.render('chart-timeline', timelineData, '#38bdf8');
        }
    } catch {}

    // 2. Initialize Replay Text Container
    renderReplayStatic();
});

function renderReplayStatic() {
    const box = document.getElementById('replay-text');
    box.innerHTML = '';
    for (let i = 0; i < targetPassage.length; i++) {
        const span = document.createElement('span');
        span.className = 'char';
        span.textContent = targetPassage[i];
        box.appendChild(span);
    }
}

function toggleReplayPlay() {
    if (isReplaying) {
        pauseReplay();
    } else {
        startReplay();
    }
}

function startReplay() {
    if (!rawEvents || rawEvents.length === 0) return;
    isReplaying = true;
    document.getElementById('btn-replay-play').textContent = '⏸ Pause';
    document.getElementById('replay-caret').style.display = 'block';

    if (replayIndex >= rawEvents.length) {
        replayIndex = 0;
        renderReplayStatic();
    }
    stepReplay();
}

function pauseReplay() {
    isReplaying = false;
    clearTimeout(replayTimer);
    document.getElementById('btn-replay-play').textContent = '▶ Resume';
}

function resetReplay() {
    pauseReplay();
    replayIndex = 0;
    document.getElementById('replay-scrubber').value = 0;
    document.getElementById('replay-time-label').textContent = `0.0s / ${totalDuration}s`;
    document.getElementById('replay-live-wpm').textContent = '0 WPM';
    renderReplayStatic();
    document.getElementById('btn-replay-play').textContent = '▶ Play Replay';
}

function stepReplay() {
    if (!isReplaying || replayIndex >= rawEvents.length) {
        pauseReplay();
        return;
    }

    const ev = rawEvents[replayIndex];
    const spans = document.querySelectorAll('#replay-text .char');

    if (ev.char_index < spans.length) {
        spans[ev.char_index].className = ev.correct ? 'char correct' : 'char incorrect';
        updateReplayCaret(spans[ev.char_index]);
    }

    const pct = Math.round((replayIndex / rawEvents.length) * 100);
    document.getElementById('replay-scrubber').value = pct;
    document.getElementById('replay-time-label').textContent = `${ev.timestamp.toFixed(1)}s / ${totalDuration}s`;

    const elapsedMin = Math.max(0.01, ev.timestamp / 60.0);
    const liveNet = Math.round(((replayIndex + 1) / 5.0) / elapsedMin);
    document.getElementById('replay-live-wpm').textContent = `${liveNet} WPM`;

    replayIndex++;

    if (replayIndex < rawEvents.length) {
        const nextEv = rawEvents[replayIndex];
        const delay = Math.max(20, Math.min(600, (nextEv.timestamp - ev.timestamp) * 1000 / replaySpeed));
        replayTimer = setTimeout(stepReplay, delay);
    } else {
        pauseReplay();
    }
}

function updateReplayCaret(targetSpan) {
    const caret = document.getElementById('replay-caret');
    const box = document.getElementById('replay-display-box');
    if (!caret || !targetSpan) return;

    caret.style.left = `${targetSpan.offsetLeft + targetSpan.offsetWidth}px`;
    caret.style.top = `${targetSpan.offsetTop + 4}px`;

    const targetMid = targetSpan.offsetTop - (box.clientHeight / 2) + 20;
    if (Math.abs(box.scrollTop - targetMid) > 15) {
        box.scrollTo({ top: Math.max(0, targetMid), behavior: 'smooth' });
    }
}

function onScrub(val) {
    pauseReplay();
    const targetIdx = Math.floor((val / 100) * rawEvents.length);
    renderReplayStatic();
    const spans = document.querySelectorAll('#replay-text .char');

    for (let i = 0; i < targetIdx; i++) {
        const ev = rawEvents[i];
        if (ev.char_index < spans.length) {
            spans[ev.char_index].className = ev.correct ? 'char correct' : 'char incorrect';
        }
    }
    replayIndex = targetIdx;
    if (targetIdx > 0 && spans[targetIdx - 1]) {
        updateReplayCaret(spans[targetIdx - 1]);
    }
}

function setReplaySpeed(spd, btn) {
    replaySpeed = spd;
    btn.parentElement.querySelectorAll('.btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active-choice'));
    btn.classList.add('active-choice');
}
</script>
{% endblock %}

<script>
const HINT_DESCRIPTIONS = {
    'easy': 'Easy Tier: High-frequency words, basic syllables, and straightforward sentence structures.',
    'moderate': 'Moderate Tier: Standard English vocabulary, natural punctuation, and realistic sentence pacing.',
    'hard': 'Hard Tier: Advanced vocabulary, longer syllables, and complex punctuation reaches.',
    'expert': 'Expert Tier: Technical terminology, dense punctuation, and irregular word rhythms.'
};

function onTypeChange(typeVal) {
    if (typeVal === 'custom') {
        window.location.href = "{{ url_for('typing.custom_text_page') }}";
        return;
    }
    const codeLangWrap = document.getElementById('cfg-code-lang-wrap');
    if (codeLangWrap) {
        codeLangWrap.style.display = (typeVal === 'code') ? 'inline-flex' : 'none';
    }
    window.typingEngine.contentType = typeVal;
    window.typingEngine.loadPrompt(false);
}

function onCodeLangChange(langVal) {
    window.typingEngine.codeLanguage = langVal;
    window.typingEngine.loadPrompt(false);
}

function onTimeChange(timeVal) {
    window.typingEngine.setDuration(timeVal);
}

function onDifficultyChange(diffVal) {
    window.typingEngine.level = diffVal;
    const hint = document.getElementById('config-explainer-hint');
    if (hint && HINT_DESCRIPTIONS[diffVal]) {
        hint.textContent = HINT_DESCRIPTIONS[diffVal];
    }
    window.typingEngine.loadPrompt(false);
}

function toggleBlindQuick() {
    const next = !window.typingEngine.blindModeActive;
    window.typingEngine.blindModeActive = next;
    const btn = document.getElementById('btn-blind');
    btn.textContent = `Blind: ${next ? 'ON' : 'OFF'}`;
    btn.classList.toggle('active-choice', next);
}

function toggleGhostQuick() {
    const next = !window.typingEngine.ghostEnabled;
    window.typingEngine.ghostEnabled = next;
    const btn = document.getElementById('btn-ghost');
    btn.textContent = `Ghost Pacer: ${next ? 'ACTIVE' : 'OFF'}`;
    btn.classList.toggle('active-choice', next);
}

function toggleAdvancedAnalyticsDrawer() {
    const drawer = document.getElementById('advanced-analytics-drawer');
    const btn = document.getElementById('btn-toggle-advanced');
    if (drawer.style.display === 'none') {
        drawer.style.display = 'block';
        btn.textContent = 'Hide Heatmap ↑';
        const targetY = drawer.getBoundingClientRect().top + window.scrollY - 54;
        window.scrollTo({ top: targetY, behavior: 'smooth' });
    } else {
        drawer.style.display = 'none';
        btn.textContent = '📊 View Key Heatmap & Biometrics ↓';
    }
}
</script>
{% endblock %}

=== FILE: .\app\utils\timezone.py ===
from datetime import datetime, timezone, timedelta, date
from typing import Tuple

# Indian Standard Time: UTC+05:30
IST_OFFSET = timedelta(hours=5, minutes=30)
IST = timezone(IST_OFFSET, name="IST")

def now_ist() -> datetime:
    """Returns current aware datetime in Indian Standard Time."""
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).astimezone(IST)

def now_utc() -> datetime:
    """Returns current naive UTC timestamp for standard DB storage."""
    return datetime.utcnow()

def to_ist(dt: datetime) -> datetime:
    """Converts a naive or aware UTC datetime to IST."""
    if dt is None:
        return now_ist()
    if dt.tzinfo is None:
        dt = dt.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
    return dt.astimezone(IST)

def ist_today() -> date:
    """Returns the current calendar date in IST."""
    return now_ist().date()

def ist_today_bounds() -> Tuple[datetime, datetime]:
    """
    Returns naive UTC datetime bounds (start, end) representing 
    00:00:00 to 23:59:59.999999 of the current IST calendar day.
    Used for strict SQL date-window queries.
    """
    current_ist = now_ist()
    start_ist = datetime(current_ist.year, current_ist.month, current_ist.day, 0, 0, 0, tzinfo=IST)
    end_ist = start_ist + timedelta(days=1)
    
    start_utc = start_ist.astimezone(timezone.utc).replace(tzinfo=None)
    end_utc = end_ist.astimezone(timezone.utc).replace(tzinfo=None)
    return start_utc, end_utc

def get_ist_hour(dt: datetime = None) -> int:
    """Returns the hour (0-23) in IST for night owl/early bird calculations."""
    target = to_ist(dt) if dt else now_ist()
    return target.hour
